program.name: Balanced Express
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: A short balanced session: a lift, a quick EMOM or AMRAP, then a stretch or core.
program.about: All three kinds of training in under half an hour. A short strength block opens each day, an EMOM or an AMRAP raises the heart rate, and a stretch or a core circuit finishes. Two days alternate. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Lift, EMOM & stretch / lift, AMRAP & core, short
